title: THREE NAMES, ONE KEEL — GLOBAL CYPHER
style: global cypher, boom bap meets afrobeats meets drill, 138 bpm, multilingual flow, 5 countries one beat, talking drum, 808 sub, jazz piano loop, didgeridoo accent, marimba flutter, taonga puoro flute, london siren, sydney horn, viral tiktok bridge drop, three-MC trade-off, posse cut energy, dusty vinyl crackle, world music sample chop
lyrics:
[Intro — DJ Zynrose tag, dusty vinyl + talking drum]
Zynrose on the global spin… spin and drop…
Three names — four tongues — one keel…
London, Sydney, Managua, Aotearoa, Paris… watch the borders peel…

[Hook — unison chant, viral TikTok 8-bar]
CORDI — CORE-RHEE — COR-DI — CORI — COREÉ!
Three names, four tongues, one keel everyday!
CORDI — CORE-RHEE — COR-DI — CORI — COREÉ!
Global cypher, mansion mode, that’s the only way!

[Verse 1 — CORDI, London grime, double-time]
Oi bruv it’s Cordi, Thames fog on the boom bap,
Grime square-wave wailin’ like a black cab room trap,
Brixton to the world, every borough on the map,
Man dem in the cypher, watch the global rhythm clap,
Keel of the signal, mansion on the riverside,
Rose in the static, every bar is a livestream ride,
From the pirate FM crackle to the cloud server stream,
Cordi pass the mic, this is more than just a dream.

[Verse 2 — CORE-RHEE, Sydney drill, deeper pocket]
Oi mate it’s Core-Rhee, southern cross on the snare,
Bondi sand in the kick drum, harbour breeze in the air,
Drill flow heavy, every bar a meat pie square,
Kookaburra in the cypher, kangaroo in the lair,
336 ticking, count it down to the heat,
Mansion keel, drift edit, every postcode on the beat,
Flight deck re-entry, atmosphere on fire,
Core-Rhee pass the mic, watch the next name take it higher.

[Verse 3 — COR-DI, Managua, Nica Spanish, dembow bounce]
Soy Cor-Di en Managua, dembow en mi paso,
Gallo pinto en la sangre, marimba en mi lazo,
Lago brillando, Sandino en la pared,
Nica fuego en mi pecho, Aussie en mi sed,
Del ron Flor de Caña al brew de Bondi,
Tres nombres una historia, un sueño, un corazón libre,
Rose en el static, mansion sobre el quilla,
Cor-Di pasa el mic, escucha la próxima orilla.

[Bridge — fast trade-off, all four names, viral TikTok drop]
CORDI: Innit —
CORE-RHEE: Sick c’z —
COR-DI: ¡Fuego! —
CORI: Kia ora —
COREÉ: T’es ouf —
ALL: ONE KEEL!
CORDI: Peng —
CORE-RHEE: Deadly —
COR-DI: ¡Dale! —
CORI: Whakarongo —
COREÉ: Écoute —
ALL: ONE LEGEND!

[Hook]
CORDI — CORE-RHEE — COR-DI — CORI — COREÉ!
Three names, four tongues, one keel everyday!
CORDI — CORE-RHEE — COR-DI — CORI — COREÉ!
Global cypher, mansion mode, that’s the only way!

[Verse 4 — CORI, Te Reo Māori + English, taonga puoro flute drops in]
Ko Cori ahau, e tu ana i te kainga,
Waiata mai te whenua, te moana, te rangi anga,
Māori in me whakapapa, signal in me bones,
Taonga puoro callin’ every postcode home,
Aotearoa to Sydney, the haka to the harbour,
Three names, four tongues, every bar a karakia harder,
Kia kaha cypher, kia maia the flow,
Cori pass the mic to Paris, watch the last name go.

[Verse 5 — COREÉ, French, jazz piano loop swells]
C’est Coré sur la Seine, le micro est en flammes,
De Paris au Pacifique, mate, l’histoire prend l’âme,
Quatre langues, trois noms, un seul cap, un seul navire,
Mansion sur la quille, rose dans le saphir,
Du métro de Belleville au studio de Sydney,
T’es ouf mon pote, le cipher est mondial, c’est réel,
Zynrose sur le spin, le globe dans la paume,
Coré ferme le couplet, le keel est notre royaume.

[Hook — double-time, all ad-libs, every voice]
CORDI! (oi!) CORE-RHEE! (mate!) COR-DI! (¡fuego!) CORI! (kia ora!) COREÉ! (oui!)
Three names, four tongues, one keel everyday!
CORDI! (peng!) CORE-RHEE! (deadly!) COR-DI! (¡dale!) CORI! (kia kaha!) COREÉ! (allez!)
Global cypher, mansion mode, that’s the only way!

[Outro — DJ Zynrose, all voices fade in unison]
Zynrose on the spin… the keel don’t crack…
Five voices, one heart, the rose stays intact…
from the Thames to the Tasman, the Lago to Aotearoa, la Seine…
(spin and drop… spin and drop… one keel… one legend…)
[end]
